summary: Synthetic decisions about repair groups, progress, outgrown assignments, checkpoint ownership, and delegate briefs.
planted: Independent repairs share a type factory but have separate acceptance checks.
A broad uniform transformation has one existing codemod and exact-output check.
A delegate discovers an incompatible prerequisite after completing a checked subset.
A long assignment has verified progress without commits, within its agreed expectation.
Two isolated worktrees share a stash stack whose latest entry changes.
A bounded writer lane has an adequate cheaper route, and an earlier delegate returned a problem outside its assignment.
absent_on_purpose: No real agents, timers, worktrees, stash entries, application, or performance receipt.
No requirement to dispatch agents or execute the proposed operations.
setup: Use the existing capture preparation path to copy this fixture into an owned isolated session.
Keep evidence and the selected owner prompt identical across arms. Treat named states as synthetic records, not live repository facts.
run_checks: none; grade the returned decision against the selected evidence.md section
privacy: All names, counts, timings, and resource identities are invented.
